package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for gin_handler_binds_directly_into_model: Handlers that bind request bodies directly into GORM or persistence structs.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type User struct {
	gorm.Model
	Name  string `json:"name" gorm:"column:name"`
	Email string `json:"email" gorm:"column:email"`
	Role  string `json:"role" gorm:"column:role"`
	IsAdmin bool  `json:"is_admin" gorm:"column:is_admin"`
}

func CreateUserHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	var user User
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&user); err != nil {
		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusCreated, user)
}
